summary.text: Sarah Rascón is a Democratic candidate for California State Senate District 26, an open seat with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election against fellow Democrat Sara Hernandez.
Her career has included work as a legislative field representative and as Director of County and Regional Affairs for Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Rascón graduated from Ramona Convent Secondary School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Merced in 2012, and Ballotpedia says she also attended Universität Potsdam.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she is described as a native Angeleno from El Sereno, raised by her immigrant grandmother, and a first-generation college graduate.
After college she worked as a community development organizer and then as a field representative in the California State Assembly for Assemblymember Jimmy Gomez.

The survey response says Rascón served as the inaugural Urban River Program Officer and then as Deputy Executive Officer of Environmental Equity for the Mountains Recreation and Conservation Authority.
It says she recently worked as Director of County and Regional Affairs for Mayor Karen Bass.
It also lists her service on the East LA Area Planning Commission, the board of CicLAvia and as a California Democratic Party delegate.
